Friendzy / Classic party games / Forbidden Letter

How to play Forbidden Letter

Say anything — just not THAT letter Pick a common letter and ban it. Players have a conversation or take turns speaking — but the second someone uses the forbidden letter, they're out.

3–10 players~10 minSneaky & ChaoticWord games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Everyone agrees on a forbidden letter (try 'S' or 'T' for a hard mode).
  2. Players take turns saying sentences in conversation.
  3. Any word containing the forbidden letter = you're out.
  4. The catch: you can ask anyone questions to try to trap them.
  5. Last one in wins.

Example round

  • Forbidden letter: 'S' — 'Can I have a drink?' works. 'Sure!' gets you eliminated.
  • Forbidden letter: 'T' — someone says 'the' in their first breath. Gone.
  • 'What time is it?' — 'T' in 'time' and 'it'. Immediate elimination.

Tips

  • Ban letters in common small words for maximum chaos: 'T', 'S', 'A', 'E'.
  • Ask trap questions: 'What's your sister's name?' to someone whose name starts with the letter.
